name: FSL Eddy (CUDA)
summary: Corrects eddy currents and motion in a single phase-encoding DWI with FSL eddy_cuda on a GPU, exposing eddy's options, and runs eddy_quad QC.
description: Builds a b0 brain mask (select_dwi_vols, bet), writes acq_params.txt from the encode and param settings, runs eddy_cuda9.1 with --cnr_maps and the chosen options, then eddy_quad. Use it when no reverse phase-encoded data is available and a CUDA GPU is; it is faster than the OpenMP App and is needed for slice-to-volume correction (mporder > 0). Note: main does not run createRegressorsTSV.py, so the regressors output is not produced in this branch.

inputs.description: DWI image with bvecs and bvals, acquired in a single phase-encoding direction.

outputs.description: Eddy-corrected DWI with eddy-rotated bvecs and the input bvals.
Intermediate files: b0 and brain mask images, index.txt and acq_params.txt.
All eddy outputs (parameters, movement RMS, outlier reports, CNR maps) and the eddy_quad QC report in qc/.

parameters.description: This is the 'dwell time'. Please see https://fsl.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/fsl/fslwiki/eddy/Faq#How_do_I_know_what_to_put_into_my_--acqp_file for more information about this specific parameter.

Phase encoding direction of the diff (not rdiff), i.e. first, inputted dwi.

for example, if the phase encoding direction of the first inputted dwi is 'PA', then select 'PA'. If it was 'AP', then select 'AP'

parameters.description: Eddy: Specifies multi-band factor (number of simultaneous slices)
Eddy: Specifies missing slices at top or bottom
Eddy: Spatial model for the field generated by eddy currents
Model for how diffusion gradients generate eddy currents
Eddy: Filter width to use for pre-filtering of data for the estimation process
Eddy: Specifies how many iterations should be run
fill empty planes
Eddy: Specifies interpolation model during estimation
Eddy: Specifies final resampling strategy
Eddy: Specifies number of voxels to use for GP hyperparameter estimation
Fudge factor that imposes Q-space smoothing during estimation
Eddy: Do not attempt to separate subject movement from field DC component. Note: eddy-bl.sh never reads this key from config.json, so it has no effect in this branch.
Eddy: Do not end with an alignment of shells to each other
Eddy: Replace outliers
Eddy: No. of standard deviations away a slice must be to qualify as an outlier
Eddy: The minimum no. of intracerebral voxels in a slice to consider it as an outlier
Eddy: Base outlier detection on slices (sw) multi-band groups (mb) or both (both)
Consider both positive and negative outliers
Eddy: Consider outliers in sum-of-squared distribution. Note: eddy-bl.sh reads the key ol_sq instead, so this setting has no effect in this branch.
Eddy: Temporal order of movement
Eddy: No. iterations for estimating slice-to-vol movement
Eddy: Strength of temporal regularisation of slice-to-vol movement.
Eddy: slice-to-volume interpolation model (--s2v_interp), trilinear or spline.
Eddy: When specified eddy estimates how the susceptibility field changes with subject movement.
Eddy: Number of iterations for susceptibility-by-movement estimation
Eddy: Specifies the balance between data and smoothness for the susceptibility rate-of-change fields
Eddy: Specifies the spline knot-spacing of the susceptibility rate-of-change fields
Eddy: Do not check that data is shelled. Trust the user
Eddy: slice acquisition order as the contents of an slspec file; when set it is written to slspec.txt and passed as --slspec. Leave empty to omit.
